job.title: Transmission Planning Engineer
job.description:
Future Permanent Opportunities | Australia Wide
Transmission Planning | Power Systems | Network Development

Considering Your Next Career Move in Transmission Planning?
EnergySync Recruitment partners with organisations across the energy, utilities and infrastructure sectors, and we're keen to connect with experienced Transmission Planning Engineers interested in future career opportunities.

Australia's energy transition continues to drive significant investment in transmission infrastructure, network development and renewable energy integration. As a result, we expect demand for experienced planning engineers to remain strong and are building relationships with talented professionals ahead of upcoming opportunities.

Whether you're actively looking or simply open to hearing about what's happening in the market, we'd welcome a confidential conversation.

Areas of Interest
We're interested in speaking with professionals who have experience in:
  • Transmission network planning and development
  • Power system studies and analysis
  • Network augmentation and reliability planning
  • Renewable energy integration
  • Grid connection and network performance assessments
  • Long-term transmission strategy and forecasting
  • Network investment planning
  • Strategic planning within transmission utilities, consulting or energy organisations
We'd Love To Hear From You If You Have Experience In
  • Transmission Planning Engineering
  • Power Systems Engineering
  • Network Planning and Development
  • Grid Connection Studies
  • System Planning or Network Strategy
  • Energy, Utilities, Transmission or Renewable Energy sectors
Why Connect With EnergySync Recruitment?
  • Stay informed about future permanent opportunities
  • Access market insights and industry trends
  • Confidential career discussions tailored to your goals
  • Build a relationship with a specialist energy recruitment partner
  • Gain early visibility of upcoming opportunities as they arise
Interested?
 
Whether you're actively considering a move or simply want to stay connected with developments across the energy sector, we'd love to hear from you.
 
Apply now or contact the EnergySync Recruitment team at info@energysyncrecruitment.com.au for a confidential discussion.
